scope: Independent HostContext, SourceContext and ChannelIntent resolution with alias handling, ambiguity, conflict preservation, and non-channel taxonomy
assertions: execution host, source platform, and target channel remain independent
an ambiguous WeChat request requires clarification and performs zero remote calls
a selected account that conflicts with the explicit target does not silently replace it

unknown host remains unknown and Douyin/TikTok retain distinct channel and locale intents
